test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Culpable
solution: The correct answer is '**Guilty**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Culpable**' is '**Guilty**'. • **Culpable**: responsible for something bad that has happened. (ग़लती के लिए ज़िम्‍मेदार; दोषी) • *Example: In public he pleads **culpable** to his part in that shock result.* • **Guilty**: having broken a law; being responsible for doing something wrong. (क़ानून तोड़ने वाला; ग़लत काम करने वाला) • *Example: She pleaded guilty/not **guilty** to the crime.* **Correct Answer:__** *Guilty.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Absolved**: to say formally that somebody does not have to take responsibility for something. (अपराध, पाप, उत्तरदायित्‍व आदि से मुक्त करना; दोषमुक्त करना, निरपराध ठहरना) • **Vindicated**: to prove that something is true or that you were right about doing something, especially when other people thought differently. (कुछ उचित ठहराना या न्‍यायसंगत सिद्घ करना) • **Acquitted**: to decide officially in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a particular crime. (विमुक्त) 39:Tae1, The correct answer is '**Optional**'.
